<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy focus:</strong> Markets remain cautious as the RBI Monetary Policy Committee meets, with widespread expectations for the repo rate to be held steady amid persistent inflation risks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPTmpQZXRCaVJPRVhJQVEzNlA0S0lmUmc1a1NqSFJ4a2F2UWhicjNKTzhDVHBGaG10NzJ5MC14bEs3VjlLbjV5MUxua2pSWnFzUTIwNTBJb2w4ZTRHQUtxU3pJQ3hxVGRZXzBQdm45cGpvOHdZZGtBQ3BKWjRQX1JyX0l5Rk40d3paN2R5b2ZiNFd2eHRXaFlzRUVYYk5JUm8xWm4zWE1rTkVTYzBscGxSdkduSUZ1MVk0eFI4d1NfRQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPLTlLSXFHSDFmajQzaXpOdGt1V24zVTV1eXF2TFpOVmRtLVllZDlaaHZRb2M2dm40Y1NrYzJiVFBiZDVwVFBuYkdTQ2p5T25hdzAwMWhGT25WZ1NlTE00ZWwxUjI5X1J1N054TGNlblR2NmdVR3Q0ZTBkSmdBUDJmVVhETQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market consolidation:</strong> Benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex retreated from recent gains, trading lower as investors adopt a wait-and-watch approach ahead of the central bank&#x27;s outcome and ongoing U.S.-Iran geopolitical developments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Corporate earnings:</strong> Market participants are closely monitoring Q1 results from major firms including Bharti Airtel, ONGC, and Dabur India, which continue to influence stock-specific movements.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I47</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I48</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil impact:</strong> Recent declines in global crude oil prices have provided a supportive backdrop for Indian equities, helping to offset some of the volatility stemming from domestic policy uncertainty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNNTkyUjVzeExScVlJZDRobXhCRWMta0xrMXpTeEE1RWd0VVM5T2oybGtERWJ4eFEtMHJnTkY3ZzhGOU1KbzJGSnMyb0pJeHo0b0dTMXZ3bm55Mm1SQjh1eTByYkN2MW9aSXBLS0RRWjYxRkRjNUF5X24xUG94bml4TmJuUlhBZ21oT1dWWnhFSlFpRVJ4ODNDVg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency stability:</strong> The Indian rupee remains largely flat against the U.S. dollar, supported by importer hedging and anticipation surrounding the upcoming RBI monetary policy announcement.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
